scares.description: Nikki gets startled by a loud noise after kissing Bear.
Nikki screams and Bear is startled.
Nikki abruptly appears after Bear turns on the lights.
Nikki briefly breaks free from the wish accompanied by a crescendoing sound.
Background music abruptly stops, Nikki walks backwards in a robotic manner, and stays still in the dark.
MAJOR SPOILER: Sarah is suddenly brutally murdered by Nikki, who smashes through the car window and repeatedly smashes a brick against her head.
Ian wishes for a billion dollars, which causes money to fall from above as Bear screams.
Nikki shoots Ian in the face
There is a sudden cut to Nikki screaming and banging on a door.
